summary.headline: Valens, Calendars, and Codex 191
summary.text: Appendix notes use dated examples from Hadrian and Antoninus Pius to verify calendar calculations, the completed years of a nativity, and the Augustan calendar reform, citing Mommsen and U. Wilcken. It then corrects conflicting datings of Valens and discusses Vatican codex 191, its treatise on the times of life and Valens’s instruments, and two chapters attributed to Hephaestio.
